;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Syrian Network for Human Rights]] reports that at least 223 documented massacres were perpetrated in 2018 by the parties to the conflict in Syria. [http://sn4hr.org/blog/2019/01/05/53003/ (Syrian Network For Human Rights)]

;Arts and culture
*[[2018 Moscow–Constantinople schism]]
**[[Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople]] [[Bartholomew I of Constantinople|Bartholomew I]] signs the independence decree ('[[Tomos (Eastern Orthodox Church)|tomos]]') officially separating the [[Orthodox Church of Ukraine|Ukrainian Orthodox Church]] from the [[Russian Orthodox Church]] as [[autocephalous]] Church. [https://www.npr.org/2019/01/05/682504351/ukrainian-orthodox-church-officially-gains-independence-from-russian-church (NPR)]

*[[2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election]]
**The Congolese [[Independent National Electoral Commission (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|election commission]] delays announcing the results of the recent election, claiming that only half the ballots have been counted. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46771360 (BBC News)]
